# Abs

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Abs(value)
```

## Description

The size of a number without its sign, so -3 and 3 both give 3. A float stays a float and an integer stays an integer. For an unsigned type, the number is never negative to begin with.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Abs(-3)
Print Abs(2.5)
Print Abs(-2.5)
```

```text
3
2.5
2.5
```
